entities.name: Rita Fernández-Queimadelos
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Rita Eugenia Fernández Benedicta Queimadelos was a Spanish architect. She is considered the second, sometimes the third female architect in Spain. The first female architect to officially sign her own architectural projects in the state. She is also the first female architect in Galicia.
